question:
A company offers different types of discounts schemes.

(i) Two successive discounts of 10% and 20%

(ii) Buy 1 get 1 free

(iii) Buy 5 get 3 free

(iv) Buy 5 get 6

Which scheme has the minimum discount percentage?
solution:
**Given data:**

Two successive discounts of 10% and 20%

Buy 1 get 1 free

Buy 5 get 3 free

Buy 5 get 6

**Concept used: **Calculation of effective discount percentage.

**Solution:**

Effective discount of two successive discounts of 10% and 20% = 10% + 20% - (10% × 20%) = 28%

Discount for Buy 1 get 1 free = 50%

Discount for Buy 5 get 3 free = (3/8) × 100 = 37.5%

Discount for Buy 5 get 6 = (1/6) × 100 = 16.66%

**Therefore, the scheme (iv) Buy 5 get 6 has a minimum discount percentage of 16.66%.**
